title: Gas / Particle Overheating Sensor Payload (Schneider PowerLogic HeatTag)

device_id.description: Unique identifier for the sensor node

timestamp.description: NTP-synced timestamp of when the reading was taken

gas_concentration_ppm.description: Concentration of outgassing products from degrading insulation in PPM

micro_particle_index.description: Index representing sub-micron particles from overheating cable sheaths

internal_panel_temp_c.description: Ambient temperature inside the switchboard panel in Celsius

rate_of_thermal_rise_c_per_min.description: Rate of temperature increase in degrees C per minute

alert_severity_level.description: HeatTag computed severity level based on gas/particle combinations
